policy: This reconciles current outcomes. Original advisor experiment plans and their hashes remain historical snapshots. Accepted new statuses are publishable only after the independent acceptance manifest passes.

items.title: Unreduced link derivatives
items.detail: Exact seven-link jets reject the independent-rotor and cross-sign mutants. Evidence: round11/skeptic/REVIEW.md and final_normal_results.json.

items.title: Haar measure and physical domain
items.detail: Independent moment and boundary checks accompany the reviewed quotient derivation. Evidence: round11 advisor proof and skeptic core audit.

items.title: Stationary spectral enclosures
items.detail: Exact rational inertia plus analytic tail bounds; no universal parameter claim beyond the separate covered region. Evidence: round11/solver/output/stationary_certificates.json.

items.title: Continuous coupling rectangle
items.detail: Exact cells cover [0,2]² at alpha=rho=1; the reviewed scaled conservative gap bound is 0.96 alpha. Evidence: round11/solver/output/continuous_rectangle_certificate.json.

items.title: Advisor consistency checks
items.detail: The 222 advisor checks are internal consistency evidence; they are not added to the independent skeptic count. Evidence: round11/advisor/advisor_checks.json.

items.title: Two-front dependency controls
items.detail: Both stationary routes and withdrawn-premise controls replay. Evidence: round11/proof_results.json and skeptic/proof_audit_results.json.

items.title: A third connected square
items.detail: Derive its actual shared-link operator, quotient/domain and independent reference before transferring shell formulas. A tensor-copy benchmark does not complete this task.

items.title: Exact dynamic representation bound
items.detail: Unitary tail blocks and Duhamel yield min(2,A^(D−d0+1)/(D−d0+1)!). Independent action, bandwidth and initial-support controls; smooth-drive certificates in solver/output.

items.title: Total computed-state error
items.status: completed for one exact rational fixture
items.detail: Two nonnegative duration-one segments, D3, Taylor order 100: total norm error below 0.000337501. Exact coefficient replay includes Gram norm, representation error and algorithm remainder; no vector renormalization.

items.title: Four smooth-drive comparisons
items.detail: Equal action gives the same conservative truncation bound but different trajectories. Reference-degree, tolerance, norm, work and midpoint checks are retained. Rigorous total floating-trajectory error remains open.

items.title: Global estimate on growing open boxes
items.detail: The estimate explicitly depends on link count and total coupling. An exact tensor-gap identity demonstrates that decay of the estimate does not prove closure of the actual gap.

items.title: Missing variance and displayed source equations
items.detail: The defined point-concentration closure fails exact compact identities; a new variance variable requires higher equations. Matrix and rank fixtures test arXiv:2608.05415v1 Eqs.8,14,18,29.

items.title: Local dynamics as a connected graph grows
items.detail: Derive a locality estimate with bounded plaquette interactions and unbounded on-link electric terms. Fix observable support, state, coefficients and physical time. Accept only a graph-independent bound with explicit boundary-distance dependence.

items.title: Controlled hierarchy instead of guessed closure
items.detail: Add positive moment-matrix and compact-support constraints to more exact identities. Seek a rigorous interval for one moment/variance. Retain closure and coefficient mutants; stop after one replayable finite hierarchy enclosure.

items.title: Four-dimensional construction and physical mass gap
items.detail: Requires matched scale/measure limits, appropriate volume control, nontriviality, reconstruction axioms and a positive rate on the full physical sector. No present proof rule supplies these premises.
